name: aeg-d-sparc
title: SPARC rotation curves: observed and baryonic accelerations of 175 disc galaxies
description: Atlas conversion of the SPARC mass models (Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016), re-issued under data standard 2.3.0 (D-083, D-084): the same g_obs and g_bar as v1, with point-scale error columns, an uncertainty-terms table naming every shared uncertainty, an observables table, and an independent second reading. See SOURCE.md, REPRODUCTION.md and REPRODUCTION_RESULT.md.
x_licence_status: Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004; to be confirmed against the terms of the CDS/VizieR record J/AJ/152/157 (issue #9). Source files are not redistributed.
x_citation: Lelli, F., McGaugh, S. S. & Schombert, J. M. 2016, AJ 152, 157; plus the rotation-curve source for each galaxy (systems table, rotation_curve_refs). Uncertainty sizes: Lelli, McGaugh, Schombert & Pawlowski 2017, ApJ 836, 152.
x_previous_version: aeg-d-sparc/v1 (standard 1.2.0); g_obs and g_bar identical (REPRODUCTION.md test 1)

x_selection.value: SPARC: 175 nearby galaxies with Spitzer [3.6] photometry and extended HI (and for about a third, Halpha) rotation curves from the literature
not a statistically complete sample (source's words: "SPARC is not a statistically complete sample")
every point of every galaxy in the mass-model table (3 391); none removed by the Atlas. The source's quality flag Q is carried as data and never used to hide rows

x_baryon_inventory.citation: Spitzer [3.6] surface photometry; V_disk and V_bul released for Υ = 1, scaled by the assumed Υ_disk = 0.5, Υ_bul = 0.7 (arXiv:1606.09251 §3.4, eq. 2). The stellar profile is extrapolated by an exponential fit beyond the last measured radius unless truncated, and the bulge linearly beyond R_bul (§3.4).

HI surface density profiles or published mass models (arXiv:1606.09251 §3.4). For D512-2, D564-8 and D631-7 the gas profile is modelled as exponential with scale length 2 R_d, because no HI surface density is available (status modelled for those three; model_dependence = observable_form on their rows).
"We neglect the contribution of molecular gas because CO data are not available for most SPARC galaxies. Fortunately, molecules constitute a minor dynamical component" (arXiv:1606.09251 §3.4)

x_search_log: None: SPARC was admitted by D-005 (week 1, 2026-10-28), before search logs existed. The A4 search (late-type and irregular galaxies, issue #48) has not yet been run (D-084 item 4, as corrected).
